cases.label: rc1 6ca56724 explicit (long)
cases.text: Decision (2026-11-18, with teammate Inês): Tidewater is keeping analytics on Postgres and has dropped the ClickHouse plan for good. Self-hosted ClickHouse was too much to operate for the small team, and the user prefers keeping everything in one database. New plan: dashboards read incrementally refreshed rollup/summary tables (never raw events), raw event tables are partitioned monthly, all in the same Postgres instance as OLTP — with a dedicated read-only analytics role (statement_timeout, work_mem caps) and a separate small analytics pool in Go alongside the OLTP pool. A read replica is the designated next step if load ever demands a split.
